text:
Maria: Quick sync — we ran a shadow audit (sentinel) for model v3-alpha-int4 against prod traffic yesterday. Need to decide auto-fallback thresholds before we promote.
Josh: Can you paste the high-level numbers? were we shadowing 100% or sample? :eyes:
Maria: Sampled ~0.5% of requests, routing to shadow endpoint with no user-visible effect. Focused on chat + summarization flows.
Maria: TL;DR: latency p50 ~ same, p95 up ~20%, p99 up ~45% for long-seq (>1024) prompts.
Carla: That's concerning for tail latency. Any quantization knob we missed? NF4 profile used.
Maria: NF4 + per-channel symmetric quant. We also tried a variant with KV-cache prefetched; marginal improvement but not enough.
Josh: What about quality signals? we need scalar metrics for gating.
Maria: Ran three evals: (1) prompt-suite BLEU/ROUGE for summarization, (2) QA F1 on anchor set, (3) hallucination heuristic (named-entity hallucination rate). Results below.
Maria: Baseline (v2.7 float): summarization ROUGE-L 42.1, QA F1 78.4, hallucination 2.1%.
Maria: Candidate (v3-alpha-int4): ROUGE-L 41.0 (-1.1 abs), QA F1 76.9 (-1.5 abs), hallucination 3.8% (+1.8x).
Eva: So quality drop ~1.2-1.5 absolute for main metrics, hallucination nearly doubled. Any stratified breakdown by user intent? (short vs long)
Maria: Short prompts: small quality delta. Long prompts (>1024): QA F1 drops ~3.2 absolute and hallucination ~+3.5%.
Carla: Given that, we should set auto-fallback rules that combine absolute and relative signals, and a tail-latency cap.
Josh: Proposed gate (draft):

```
rollout_gates:
  min_traffic: 0.1 # percent
  quality_abs_drop:
    - metric: QA_F1
      threshold: 1.5 # absolute points
    - metric: ROUGE_L
      threshold: 1.0
  hallucination_rel_increase:
    threshold: 1.5 # multiplier
  latency_p99_ratio:
    threshold: 1.4 # candidate / baseline
  decision: if any above -> immediate fallback
  hysteresis: 2m window, require persistent violation on >= 3 checks
```

Josh: That would cause fallback on any single signal breach. Thoughts?
Carla: I worry about too-sensitive hallucination multiplier for low-base rates. 2.1% -> 3.8% is big but absolute is 1.7pp. Maybe add a minimum absolute delta for hallucination (e.g., >=1.0pp) so noise doesn't flip it.
Eva: Also separate rules for long-seq traffic. We don't want long-tail customers to flip whole rollout. Suggest scoped gates by route tag: `long_seq=true`.
Maria: Good call. Also want a soft-stop: if only latency p99 ratio breaches but quality is OK, we should throttle traffic not immediate fallback for hosted customers.
Josh: Agree — update decision logic: for hosted tiers: latency-only -> throttle to 50% for 10 min, quality/hallucination -> immediate fallback. For dedicated customers allow relaxed latency thresholds per contract.
Maria: We added a sentinel job to the canary runner. Config snippet we pushed:

```
canary_runner:
  sentinel_prompts: s3://redwood-evals/sentinels/v3-alpha/combined.jsonl
  sampling: 0.5%
  shadow_mode: true
  metrics: [ROUGE_L, QA_F1, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, latency_p99]
  gates: rollout_gates.yaml
```

Maria: deploy-bot ran the shadow and posted aggregated snapshot at 2200000008.
deploy-bot: shadow-run complete for 2199999999. samples=42,312. snapshot: {"ROUGE_L": {"base":42.1,"cand":41.0}, "QA_F1": {"base":78.4,"cand":76.9}, "halluc_rate": {"base":0.021,"cand":0.038}, "lat_p99_ratio":1.45}
Carla: deploy-bot numbers align with Maria's. With latency p99 ratio 1.45 > 1.4 threshold so latency-only fallback logic would throttle.
Josh: But hallucination_rel_increase 1.81 > 1.5 and abs halluc delta 0.017 > 0.01 -> triggers quality fallback.
Eva: So the combined logic would cause an immediate rollback for hosted. For dedicated, we might hold and do targeted patching.
Maria: Action items:
- Josh: update rollout_gates.yaml to add hallucination_abs_delta: 0.01 and route scoping. (ETA EOD)
- Carla: spin up a targeted long-seq shadow with 5% sampling and alternative int4 kernel (per-channel asymmetric) to see if tail improves. (ETA tomorrow)
- Eva: draft customer-facing note for Dedicated that tail-latency may vary with quant profiles. (ETA 48h)
- Maria: block promotion until gates updated + new long-seq shadow run completes.
Josh: I'll open a PR for the gates and add unit tests for the decision logic.
Carla: small ask — add a metric for token-efficiency (tokens/sec) to the snapshot so cost/throughput tradeoffs are clearer.
Maria: added to backlog, will add to sentinel_prompts job.
Eva: thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maria: closing for now — will reopen thread with new snapshot.
